newsitem.title: GREECE: SIMITIS ONE OF GREECE'S MOST POPULAR POLITICIANS.
newsitem.headline: SIMITIS ONE OF GREECE'S MOST POPULAR POLITICIANS.

text.p: Socialist Prime Minister Costas Simitis and Nikos Constantopoulos, leader of the small leftist coalition party, are the most popular politicians in Greece, according to the latest opinion poll.
Simitis and Constantopoulos each scored 57 percent in the poll in the greater Athens region by Metron Analysis for Flash radio.
For Simitis it was a solid showing less than three weeks ahead of national elections but well down on his 70 percent rating after taking over as prime minister in January.
Third place went to Dimitris Tsovolas of the new left-wing DIKKI party with 48.6 percent and fourth to Miltiadis Evert, the main opposition conservative leader, with 31.9 percent.
Nationalist party leader Antonis Samaras scored 29 percent and Communist Party leader Aleka Papriga scored 22.2 percent. --Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
